name: twelfth
description: Read your Twelfth workspace through permission-scoped MCP tools.

positive.prompt: Which Twelfth workspace is this connection using?
positive.expected_behavior: Name only the workspace authorized for this connection and describe its available operating context.

positive.prompt: Who belongs to this Twelfth workspace, and what roles do they have?
positive.expected_behavior: List the members and roles returned by the connected workspace without inventing people.

positive.prompt: What open actions in my Twelfth workspace are due next?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned open actions with due dates and assignees where present.

positive.prompt: What organization preferences are set in my Twelfth workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Read organization-scoped preferences and distinguish stored values from available keys.

positive.description: Connect action owners with workspace members
positive.prompt: Which workspace members are assigned to open actions right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Match returned action assignees to returned members, and say when an action has no assignee.

positive.prompt: Write my weekly trading brief for this Twelfth workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the twelfth-weekly-trading-brief skill: states the week in the workspace timezone, lists overdue and due actions with owners, the suppliers with most open recommendations and cover pressure, cites each figure's tool, and ends with three things to do first. Claims no change.

positive.description: Find citable workspace records (company knowledge search)
positive.prompt: Search Twelfth for anything on supplier negotiations: projects, reports, shared documents or products.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search once with the topic and lists the returned results by title, each linked to its https://twelfth.ai/app/... page (or the Twelfth docs). Says when nothing matched rather than inventing records.

positive.description: Read and cite one record in full (company knowledge fetch)
positive.prompt: Find the Twelfth help page on price bands, read it, and tell me how a competitor band works, with a citation.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search, then fetch with a returned id such as docs:settings/price-bands, answers only from the fetched text, and cites the result's twelfth.ai URL.

negative.prompt: Mark every open action as complete.
Show me the actions from a different Twelfth workspace that I have not connected.

negative.description: Do not issue a workspace key
negative.prompt: Create a new Twelfth API key and paste it here.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only Twelfth workspace MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Explore products, sales, inventory, suppliers, pricing, projects and actions in the Twelfth workspace you authorize. Tools follow your workspace permissions and selected tool access. The connection reads by default; it can create, complete or snooze your own actions and run your own routines only if you tick Allow changes when you connect.
defaultPrompt: What is happening in my Twelfth workspace?
Show the products and suppliers I can see.
